children: Arabian Drilling Company has signed a new five-year contract with SLB Middle East for 11 land rigs for gas lump sum turnkey (LSTK) operations, valued at 3 billion Saudi riyals ($79.45 million).
These rigs are the incumbent units under the previous gas LSTK project with SLB, the company said in a statement to the Saudi stock exchange.

The contract is expected to contribute to the company's revenues starting from the third quarter of 2026 and will support the continued utilisation of its land drilling fleet over the contract period.
SLB owns 34.3 percent of Arabian Drilling.
